caption_draft: Wall-clock, wall-clock per prompt, peak allocated and reserved memory, checkpoint and lens bytes, and matrix finite rate for Fit A and Fit B.

title: Selected and excluded headroom cells
research_question: Which task cells qualify as ablation substrates?
caption_draft: Per-cell adjudicated accuracy with Wilson 95% CI, truncation rate, no-answer rate, unresolved count, selection outcome, and exclusion reason, for all 30 family x band x condition cells.
limitations: n=10 per cell; selection thresholds are preregistered but the sample is a screen, not an estimate, and the intervals are wide. 20 of 30 cells are classified not_adjudicated because they contain at least one row adjudicated unresolved, so their accuracy cells are empty by design rather than zero. Truncation and no-answer rates come from the deterministic screening flags: truncation is the objective 512-token-cap signal, but no-answer reflects parser v2 answer-presence detection, which is screening only.

title: Independent-fit replication criteria and outcomes
research_question: Do two independently fitted same-size J-lenses meet the registered replicate thresholds?
caption_draft: Registered criterion| threshold| measured value and pass or fail for the three transport gates and the two replicate criteria| with the merged-50 improvement margins.
limitations: Both replicate criteria failed. REPLICATE_IMPROVING states that transport worked and that the merge lands between its two inputs; it is not a statement about lens quality and licenses no semantic claim.

title: J-lens disjoint-fit resource and held-out apply summary

caption_draft: Fit wall clock| wall clock per prompt| peak reserved GPU memory| checkpoint and lens bytes for the 25B sharded fit| plus per-lens and per-pair held-out top-k overlap and rank correlation.
